headline: X adds parental controls for teen accounts
pages: X has added parental controls for teenage users after 20 years. Accounts of 13 to 17 year olds will default to protected mode, which blocks sensitive content and targeted ads. Parents can see weekly time spent on X, set daily limits, approve new followers, limit feed recommendations to followed accounts, filter words, and choose who can message their teen. They can also see who the teen is messaging. Unlike many platforms, X lets teens see the restrictions placed on their accounts. Parents cannot read private messages, see search or viewing history, or post as their teen. The controls follow criticism that X's AI chatbot could be used to generate sexualized images of children and women.
A 2024 study found nearly a third of Gen Alpha kids have an X account. Source: TechCrunch.
